failure_modes.failure_effect_local: Sensor reports 0.0 m water level regardless of actual level
failure_modes.failure_effect_system: Controller never activates pumps; bilge floods unchecked
failure_modes.failure_effect_end: Flooding risk, possible hull ingress — Loss L-0, L-1
failure_modes.failure_cause: Transducer corrosion; wiring short to ground; firmware hang
failure_modes.recommended_action: Add independent high-water float switch as hardware backup; heartbeat watchdog on sensor output

failure_modes.failure_effect_local: Sensor always reports maximum water level
failure_modes.failure_effect_system: Continuous pump operation, rapid wear, potential dry-run damage
failure_modes.failure_effect_end: Premature pump failure; nuisance alarms desensitise crew
failure_modes.failure_cause: Transducer calibration drift; moisture ingress into electronics
failure_modes.recommended_action: Implement median-of-3 sensor voting; plausibility check against pump flow feedback

failure_modes.failure_mode: Total loss of flow (blocked strainer or seized impeller)
failure_modes.failure_effect_system: Discharge capacity halved; redundant pump must absorb full inflow
failure_modes.failure_effect_end: If Pump B also unavailable — Loss L-1
failure_modes.failure_cause: Debris ingestion into strainer; impeller seizure at high run hours
failure_modes.recommended_action: Install differential pressure sensor across strainer; trigger alarm on ΔP > threshold

failure_modes.failure_effect_system: Net discharge flow may fall below design inflow threshold
failure_modes.failure_effect_end: Risk of DischargeCapacityRequirement violation during peak inflow
failure_modes.failure_cause: Low suction head; high water temperature; entrained air from bilge
failure_modes.recommended_action: Model cavitation onset via NPSH margin constraint; install vibration sensor

failure_modes.failure_mode: Redundant pump unavailable — independent power bus lost
failure_modes.failure_effect_local: pumpB.isRedundant effectively false; no independent power feed
failure_modes.failure_effect_system: PumpRedundancyRequirement violated; single point of failure
failure_modes.failure_effect_end: Combined with Pump A failure — Loss L-1
failure_modes.failure_cause: Emergency bus breaker tripped; cable fault on independent feed
failure_modes.recommended_action: Periodic bus transfer test; power supply redundancy monitoring

failure_modes.failure_mode: Controller software hang — no outputs issued
failure_modes.failure_effect_local: No pump commands, no alarm output; responseTime_s becomes infinite
failure_modes.failure_effect_system: Bilge floods unchecked; all automation paths fail
failure_modes.failure_effect_end: Loss L-0, L-1 in severe flooding scenario
failure_modes.failure_cause: Watchdog timer failure; memory corruption; firmware bug on edge case input
failure_modes.recommended_action: Hardware watchdog with independent reset; controller self-test heartbeat to bridge alarm

failure_modes.failure_mode: Alarm output inhibited (maintenance mode not cleared)
failure_modes.failure_effect_local: controller.alarmOut always false despite trigger condition
failure_modes.failure_effect_system: AlarmResponseRequirement violated; crew unaware of flooding
failure_modes.failure_cause: Maintenance inhibit flag persists after dry-dock; no auto-timeout
failure_modes.recommended_action: Implement maximum inhibit duration (e.g., 30 min); require active re-inhibit after timeout

failure_modes.failure_mode: Failover logic not executed on Pump A fault detection
failure_modes.failure_effect_local: controller.pumpBControl not asserted when Pump A faulted
failure_modes.failure_effect_system: UCA_004 scenario — Pump B stays idle; discharge capacity = 0
failure_modes.failure_effect_end: Combined with high inflow — Loss L-1
failure_modes.failure_cause: Pump health assessed by power draw, not flow measurement; cavitation not detected
failure_modes.recommended_action: Add flow feedback sensor on each pump discharge; controller compares measured vs expected flow
